about: City of Wood River-Mississippi River drains about 19 square miles, 6% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 560 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 410 feet at its lowest. Its main stream is Wood River. It includes part of West Alton. Its water flows on down the Mississippi River.
